sections.heading: 릴리스/로드맵
sections.body:
**Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work**

Anthropic launched Claude Cowork, extending the Claude Code agent loop to non-coding knowledge work on desktop with folder-scoped access, scheduled unattended t

영향: The same agent runtime now targets legal, finance, and operations workflows beyond the terminal, expanding the surface area teams must evaluate for permissions 

> Schedule a task for any cadence, and it runs unattended. You come back to your deck, spreadsheet, or research.

[원문 확인](https://claude.com/blog/cowork-research-preview)

**v2.1.239**

v2.1.239는 비용 추정(US 데이터 레지던시 1.1× 프리미엄 반영), Bedrock/Vertex 등 풀스크린 렌더러·/claude-api upgrade, Alpine/musl 네이티브 확장 로드, Windows 교차 세션 SendMessage, 클라우드 플러그인 @synced 표

영향: 특히 Bedrock 프록시에서 Content-Type 헤더가 제거될 때 스트리밍이 실패해 턴마다 비스트리밍으로 재실행되며 API 호출이 조용히 2배 과금되던 문제가 수정되었다 — 엔터프라이즈·프록시 환경 비용 감사에 직접 영향한다.

> Fixed Bedrock streaming behind proxies that strip the response Content-Type header, which silently doubled billed API calls by re-running every turn non-streaming

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.239)

sections.heading: 회귀·보안 신호
sections.body:
**Claude Code is steganographically marking requests**

Analysis of Claude Code 2.1.196 shows the client can alter the system-prompt date line (Unicode apostrophe variants and YYYY/MM/DD separators) based on ANTHROPI

영향: Developers routing Claude Code through internal gateways or custom base URLs may unknowingly inject hidden classification markers into every request, complicati

> This is prompt steganography, a technique used to hide data in plain sight. The visible sentence still reads like a normal date.

[원문 확인](https://thereallo.dev/blog/claude-code-prompt-steganography)

**The Claude Code Source Leak: fake tools, frustration regexes, undercover mode**

After an accidental npm source-map leak, researchers documented anti-distillation fake-tool injection, undercover mode that hides AI authorship, native client a

영향: The leak exposes how Anthropic enforces first-party client use and poisons distillation traffic, shaping what third-party harness builders and security reviewer

> When enabled, Claude Code sends anti_distillation: ['fake_tools'] in its API requests. This tells the server to silently inject decoy tool definitions into the system prompt.

[원문 확인](https://alex000kim.com/posts/2026-03-31-claude-code-source-leak/)

**Claude Code refuses requests or charges extra if your commits mention "OpenClaw"**

A third-party harness detection bug ingested git status into the system prompt and keyword-matched strings like OpenClaw and HERMES.md in commit messages or fil

영향: Subscription users can be silently overcharged or blocked based on incidental strings in git history, not actual third-party harness usage.

> [BUG] Literal "HERMES.md" in git commit messages triggers 400 "out of extra usage" on Max OAuth (content filter false-positive misclassified as quota error)

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/53171)

**Enterprise managed settings in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains**

GitHub Copilot for JetBrains에 엔터프라이즈 관리 설정이 추가되었다. 관리자가 플러그인·마켓플레이스(enabledPlugins·extraKnownMarketplaces·strictKnownMarketplaces), MCP 서버(allowedMcpServers·den

영향: JetBrains IDE 사용자도 VS Code와 유사한 Copilot MCP·권한 거버넌스를 받을 수 있어, 멀티 IDE 조직의 에이전트 보안·감사 정책을 일관되게 적용할 수 있다.

> Administrators can use allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers to centrally control which MCP servers developers can connect to from GitHub Copilot for JetBrains.

[원문 확인](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-08-18-enterprise-managed-settings-in-github-copilot-for-jetbrains)

**v2.1.234**

Claude Code v2.1.234(2026-08-17)은 Windows NT-namespace(\??\) 경로를 원격 파일 읽기·세션 복원·CLAUDE.md include·워크플로 스크립트·업로드에서 거부해 NTLM 자격증명 유출 벡터를 막고, 사용량 한도 리셋 시 세션 자동 재개,

영향: 엔터프라이즈·장시간 세션 사용자에게 보안 하드닝과 권한/빌링 UX 회귀가 동시에 영향을 주므로, 에이전트 도구를 운영·평가하는 팀은 업그레이드 후 샌드박스 네트워크 권한·백그라운드 서브에이전트 권한 프롬프트·MCP 설정 진단 동작을 재검증할 필요가 있다.

> Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (\??\) paths

[원문 확인](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.234)

**Claude Code's source code has been leaked via a map file in their NPM registry**

@anthropic-ai/claude-code v2.1.88 npm 패키지에 60MB cli.js.map가 포함되어 약 1,900파일·50만 줄 TypeScript 소스가 sourcesContent로 노출되었다. Anthropic은 패키징 오류로 확인했다.

영향: 클로즈드 CLI의 전체 구현·미출시 기능 단서가 공개되면서, 공급망 패키징 실수가 제품 로드맵·안티어뷰징 설계를 역으로 드러내는 사례가 된다.

> Earlier today, a Claude Code release included some internal source code. No sensitive customer data or credentials were involved or exposed.

[원문 확인](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/artificial-intelligence/claude-code-source-code-accidentally-leaked-in-npm-package/)
